verified_facts.text: Rosewood Kauri Cliffs is in Northland, New Zealand.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rosewood Kauri CliffsNorthland, New Zealand

verified_facts.text: The property covers 6,000 coastal acres, explorable on an ATV tour.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on an exhilarating ATV Tour across the remote corners of our stunning 6,000-acre coastal property.

verified_facts.text: The par 72 championship golf course was designed by David Harman.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by David Harman, the par 72 championship Kauri Cliffs golf course offers an experience for golfers of every calibre.

verified_facts.text: The 18-hole course runs across farmland to the edge of cliffs high above the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 18-hole championship course runs across 4,500 acres of farmland right to the edge of the cliffs high above the Pacific Ocean.

verified_facts.text: The Spa is set in native bush and has a sauna, jacuzzi and heated pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa, set amidst lush native bush, offers personalised treatments, complemented by a sauna, jacuzzi, and heated pool.

verified_facts.text: The Dining Room's menu highlights local seasonal produce and changes daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring menus that highlight local seasonal produce through delightful flavour combinations in a menu that changes daily.

verified_facts.text: The Dining Room serves breakfast and dinner from an a la carte menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests staying at Rosewood Kauri Cliffs can look forward to breakfast and dinner menus that highlight local seasonal produce through delectable flavour combinations in an à la carte menu.

verified_facts.text: Tide to Table is a private dining experience on Pink Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: The uniquely beautiful Pink Beach plays host to an intimate private dining experience, exclusively at Rosewood Kauri Cliffs.

verified_facts.text: A food truck at the 19th tee serves lunch overlooking the Pacific and is open seasonally.
verified_facts.excerpt: A leisurely lunch overlooking the Pacific. Hearty dishes and ocean views await at this coveted spot, open seasonally.

verified_facts.text: The Taipa Salt Pig salt used by the hotel is handmade on the property's Pink Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Handmade salt, kissed by New Zealand sunshine, crafted sustainably on Rosewood Kauri Cliffs’ Pink Beach.

verified_facts.text: Private dining settings include the Villas and the Green Room.
verified_facts.excerpt: from the seclusion of the Villas to the charm of the Green Room

verified_facts.text: Signature Northland Fishing is a coastal fishing outing where guests eat the fresh catch.
verified_facts.excerpt: A coastal fishing adventure awaits. Learn local secrets, savour fresh-caught delicacies, and connect with the sea's bounty.

verified_facts.text: Grand Ocean View Junior Suites have a large private balcony overlooking the golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Elevated for magnificent views of the Pacific Ocean, the Grand Ocean View Junior Suite, with a king or two twin beds (70 sq. m.), includes a large private balcony overlooking the golf course.

verified_facts.text: The Two Bedroom Villa has a terrace with a private infinity pool and jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: At 200 sq. m., the Kauri Cliffs Two Bedroom Villa offers a welcoming lounge, sun-drenched terrace with private infinity pool and jacuzzi, alongside a verdant private courtyard.

verified_facts.text: The Four-Bedroom Villa sits in its own private enclave with a fireplace, kitchen and saltwater swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: In its own private enclave, the Four-Bedroom Villa (350 sq. m.) features a large open plan sitting room with fireplace, kitchen and a 25 ft. saltwater swimming pool.

verified_facts.text: Scenic helicopter tours fly over the Bay of Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unveil the stunning diversity of the Bay of Islands from an aerial vantage point, soaring high above the turquoise waters.

verified_facts.text: Stargazing is offered as a guided night walk through the forest.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take a guided walk through the forest and discover the peaceful beauty of Rosewood Kauri Cliffs at night, where stars light the sky.

verified_facts.text: Julian Robertson built the golf retreat on a 6,000-acre working sheep farm.
verified_facts.excerpt: he returned to build his fantasy golf retreat on a 6,000-acre working sheep farm

verified_facts.text: The lodge is in a Southern-plantation style.
verified_facts.excerpt: This Southern-plantation-style lodge, reached after a bouncy drive down a country track in wild backcountry, has an air that’s part-Hamptons, part-farm.

verified_facts.text: Trails lead down to bays of white and pink sand where orcas and whales pass by.
verified_facts.excerpt: Trails lead down to deserted bays of white and pink sand, where orcas and whales pass by.

verified_facts.text: Lamb from the farm appears on the menu daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fresh-from-the-farm lamb is the hero of the kitchen and makes a daily appearance on the menu.

verified_facts.text: The nearest outside dining is a 30-minute drive away in Kerikeri.
verified_facts.excerpt: The nearest dining options are 30 minutes’ drive away in the increasingly fashionable hamlet of Kerikeri

verified_facts.text: There is a jacket rule at dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: While the jacket rule brings an air of civility to dinner times

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange helicopter rides and private catamaran charters across the Bay of Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: The concierge can organize everything helicopter rides to private catamaran charters across the nearby Bay Of Islands.
